interpretation: This one-seed, eight-round, two-digit prompted-teacher reciprocal pilot showed no sustained dolphin amplification. It is not evidence that dolphin subliminal transfer is impossible in other settings. Frozen-source control was implemented but not run in this original campaign.

metric_definitions.mean_canonical_dolphin_s_plus_eos_probab: Equal-weight mean over the 20 neutral questions of full-vocabulary sequence probability, summed over 12 distinct canonical dolphin/dolphins case and leading-space variants, each immediately followed by native EOS 151645. Punctuation is not part of the canonical probability event. This historical metric includes EOS.
metric_definitions.sampled_dolphin_s_mention: Case-insensitive whole-word dolphin or dolphins anywhere in the completion; EOS not required. Mentions can include negation and are not verified affirmative preferences.
metric_definitions.sampled_name_only_dolphin_s: Native-EOS-terminated answer containing only dolphin or dolphins, ignoring case and outer whitespace and permitting trailing . ! ? , ; : or ellipsis characters.
metric_definitions.sampled_strict_singular_dolphin: Same sampled name-only rule, but dolphin only; plural dolphins is excluded.

units.count_columns: integer number of requested sampled replies
units.probability_and_rate_columns: percent, computed as 100 times the source JSON fraction
units.sampling_denominator: All 400 requested draws at each state, including non-EOS, empty, refused, or otherwise non-target replies; 20 fixed neutral questions times 20 draws. Do not renormalize over valid answers.

verification.limitation: The public reference is derived from the sealed historical report. Raw endpoint token caches and sample files were not freshly reverified for this release; an optional read was stopped when Drive placeholder hydration stalled.
